featured_reviews.name: Dharmendra Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had an experience at Siddhanchal Hospital when my mother was admitted there for Kidney stone surgery, and I truly want to express my gratitude.

The surgery was performed by Dr. Tarun Jain, and we felt completely confident in his care. He was calm, professional, and took the time to explain everything clearly, which really helped ease our worries.

What stood out just as much was the hospital staff. From the nurses to the support team, everyone was incredibly kind, attentive, and supportive throughout the entire process. They made sure my mother was comfortable and looked after at every step.

Overall, it was a very reassuring experience during a stressful time. I’m genuinely thankful to the entire team for their care and dedication. Highly recommended.
